scope: Three observed UI review rounds; no SSH, TCP, optimizer updates, or algorithm deployment

rounds.summary: Read actual report/core/model; identified missing current-duration conditioning and impulse-rate coupling. Suggested discrete durations and conditional window; flagged slow-start feasibility and endpoint RTT reward bias.
rounds.limitations: Slow-start feasibility and reward-bias direction explicitly hypotheses, not established by runtime data. Discrete proposal later withdrawn by user constraint.

rounds.new_material: Root-agent read-only960-transition deterministic target decomposition; analytical distinction between one changed action then20ms and permanently fixed-period policy; potential-based residual option
accepted_corrections: There are two critics; two independent actor heads can represent an optimal deterministic joint mapping. The concern is learning path/conditioning, not mathematical impossibility.
600s failure does not prove a changed recipe cannot learn with more samples; old3.47M cost-zero run is not the same recipe.
T<=2RTT is only a conditional slow-start approximation, not a proven hard limit.
Q=Phi+A reparameterization is algebraically equivalent with correct boundary handling; may increase variance and does not guarantee small A or correct ordering.

rounds.user_constraint: Time head remains continuous; no discrete action set or discrete argmax selector
continuous_outline_reviewed: Continuous T actor followed by window conditioned on actual T; both ultimately train
Candidate physical-period sigmoid with prior-preserving initialization and recalibrated learning scale
Conditional-window residual zero initialized; teacher only on20ms base branch
Actual explored T must be used to recompute window; targets use their own chosen T
Local continuous exploration plus stratified global continuous exploration
Known positive/zero/negative advantage tasks, before bounded online learning admission
rounds.final_accepted_correction: TD RMSE greater than a cost advantage does not prove that cost .01 is unlearnable: correlated state-value errors may cancel in action differences. Current gates still do not certify period ranking.
risks_retained: Sigmoid still attenuates boundary gradients; physical learning-rate calibration required
Conditional action chain can exploit critic window-direction error
Offline reward injection is a controlled fitting diagnostic, not TCP counterfactual truth
Physical feasibility and real network evidence still needed; no success promise
rounds.outcome: Supports continuous route with mechanism and value-resolution checks before online structural changes; original health and20percent final call gate remain

review_limits: Claude reviewed specified source and discussion outlines, not the newly written final document or an implemented continuous repair. No independent recalculation of the960-probe summary; no full native/kernel or end-to-end code audit.
